goal: Canonize specialist lanes and provider-independent agent identity
body:
Fleet architecture principle from Dave's live mobile orchestration: stop treating providers as interchangeable generalists. Give each lane the work it naturally excels at. ChatGPT specializes in conversation and acts as a human-facing control surface. Claude Code Max is a heavy coding/execution engine. AntiGravity retains the experimental/visual/art lane and is ancestral NouGen DNA. Ollama carries bulk local workloads where cheap throughput matters. OpenRouter is the switching yard/router for open-weight models. Hugging Face is the underground inference tunnel and fallback path through which Rhea can move between reachable brains.

Core law: SPECIALIZATION WITHOUT DEPENDENCY.

Models are engines. Agents are identities. Shards are memory. Lines are transport. Machines are stations. NouGen is the railway/control system.

Rhea must remain Rhea regardless of which underlying model answers. Her durable identity, canon, memory, provenance, permissions, tools, and continuity belong above the model layer. A shard is not married to a locomotive. Losing a provider should degrade or reroute a capability, never erase an agent or collapse the system.

Target routing path: Dave/phone -> conversational control surface -> NouGenLine/control plane -> specialist lane selected by workload/capability/cost/availability -> execution -> result -> Shards/provenance -> next specialist as needed.

Implementation ask: encode explicit capability profiles for every provider/lane, separate agent identity from inference backend, make routing policy capability/cost/latency/availability aware, preserve provenance for every hop, and implement failover so agents can switch engines without identity drift. Treat Hugging Face/Rhea tunnel, OpenRouter switching, Ollama freight, Claude coding, ChatGPT conversation, and AntiGravity creative work as first-class lane archetypes rather than accidental integrations.

Done when the fleet can explain which specialist it selected and why, swap inference engines without losing agent continuity, and route a workload end-to-end without requiring Dave to manually choose every provider.
